# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 12 (Bi-Vb Np12)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Np12
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 12
**Title (English, SuttaCentral):** 12. Getting an expensive light cloak in exchange

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Lahupāvuraṇa-sikkhāpada* ("Getting an expensive light cloak in exchange"), classified as Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 12 (Bi-Vb Np12), is an ecclesiastical rule belonging to the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The rule stipulates that a nun who requests or obtains an excessively expensive, light outer-robe in exchange must forfeit the robe and confess the offense [SuttaCentral]. An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].

The rule has extensive parallels across early Buddhist Vinaya lineages. Curated parallels cataloged by SuttaCentral include the Pali Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Np 12) and Bhikkhunī Parivāra (Np 12), as well as corresponding rules in Chinese, Sanskrit, and Tibetan recensions: Dharmaguptaka (Np 30), Mahīśāsaka (Np 24), Sarvāstivāda (Np 30), Mūlasarvāstivāda (Np 33), Mahāsāṃghika (Np 20), and Mahāsāṃghika-Lokottaravāda Sanskrit (*Bhikṣuṇīvinaya* Np 20) [SuttaCentral]. Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus records substantial text reuse with adjacent Nissaggiya Pācittiya rules, showing its highest overlap with Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 11 (§1.1–2.2.11 shared with §1.1–2.3.11), as well as Nissaggiya Pācittiya 10, Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 6, and the *Bhesajjakkhandhaka* (Kd 6) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of the text with Sanskrit Prātimokṣa and Bhikṣuṇīvinaya passages, as well as Tibetan Vinaya commentaries and treatises in the Kangyur and Tengyur (*Vinaya-uttaragrantha* D0007A and *Pratimokṣasūtraṭīkāvinayasamuccaya* D4106-3) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
